comments.body: There is a service called Publibike that has a special discount for ETH stusents. You can pay an anual fee of around 70chf (maybe more now, maybe less, but you can find that online) and use e-bikes from the designated stations for free during 30 mins. You have to return them to the stations always, but there are enough and in useful enough places that it should not be a problem. You may be unlucky with availability in very popular areas, though (for example, the ones around ETH get filled with ebikes in the morning and get emptied in the afternoon quite fast, obviously).
comments.author: Triple_L_Master
